verdict.rationale: Vast.ai offers a CLI, SDK and REST API that a user could script into their own automations, plus an agent skill that lets external coding assistants act on the platform. Those are developer building blocks and a host-agent integration, not a product feature for defining background automations. Autobilling and serverless autoscaling are fixed, narrow platform behaviors rather than user-defined automations, and no first-party scheduler, triggers or recurring background jobs are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
Use the autobilling feature to have the system automatically top up your account using a saved credit card when it runs low.
